headline: FCC to vote on letting prisons jam cellphone signals
summary: FCC Chairman Brendan Carr wants to let prisons use signal jammers, and the agency is set to vote on the new rules, with one report citing November 19th as the date. Jammers are generally banned under decades-old federal law, though some federal facilities already have exceptions, and the vote would relax that long-standing policy.
